notes.title: Update notes for v1.0.3.4
notes.content:
[b]What's new:[/b]
Added 5 new drops!
Rewards from the tournament will now be given automatically based on your position every Sunday!

[b]Fixes:[/b]
Fixed an issue at the start of the game that was causing it to freeze for a few seconds.
Fixed an issue with weekly missions that was causing them not to reset correctly.
Fixed issue with leaderboards.

Thank you all for your support and helping building this awesome game so far!
If you are not part of our community in [b]Discord[/b], feel free to join here:

[url=https://discord.gg/GqtBucEfqC][b]https://discord.gg/GqtBucEfqC[/b][/url]

notes.title: Update Notes for v1.0.3.1
notes.content:
[b]What's new:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added new Halloween event!
[*]New event store to buy exclusive inventory drops.
[/list]

[b]Various fixes[/b]


Starting today, October 29th and until the 5th of November, join us in Cactiverse for a spooktacular Halloween adventure!

Mount your dragon and embark on a Trick or Treat journey around the Tropical Island to gather delicious candies. Collect as many as you can and use them to purchase spooky cacti (only available during the event) from our exclusive in-game Halloween Store!

Best of all, any cacti you buy with candies will be added immediately to your Steam Inventory.

Have fun, and Happy Halloween to everyone!

tags.feature: -Added new Halloween event!
- New event store to buy exclusive inventory drops.

notes.title: Major Update notes for v1.0.3.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149422/761c776a924e9a6287d127022e3bdf5a4d183b5f.png[/img]
[b]What's new:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new Tropical Island for you to explore!
[*]New minimap added at the bottom right of your screen.
[*]New compass added at the top of the screen to show points of interest!
[*] A new popup was added in the Settings menu for reporting Bugs or anything else found in the game that you want to share.
[*] Button G now unlocks and locks the cursor.
[*] Button N opens the Map in bigger size for you to explore!
[*] Two new achievements!
[*] Dragon can now swim!
[/list]

Thank you all for your support and helping building this awesome game so far!
If you are not part of our community in Discord feel free to join here:

[url=https://discord.gg/GqtBucEfqC]https://discord.gg/GqtBucEfqC[/url]
